scene_report.description: Klothys Titan prison V2: Demon and Orc animated CC0 bodies are baked from rigged sources, compacted and wrapped into the exact 220 m stone sphere as carbonite-style reliefs. The central +/-40 degree front sector stays open for the future full-height Klothys figure and binding hair.
design_references: User-approved concept: two full creature silhouettes imprisoned in a cracked runic stone sphere
